ruleDefinitions.name: Windows LAPS Credential Dump From Entra ID
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when an account dumps the LAPS password from Entra ID. Note: Unmapped fields: category, activityType, additionalDetails.additionalInfo

sequences.query: (category = "Device" AND activityType = RGX(".*Recover\\ device\\ local\\ administrator\\ password.*") AND additionalDetails.additionalInfo = RGX(".*Successfully\\ recovered\\ local\\ credential\\ by\\ device\\ id.*"))
